steps.content: The elevator finally reaches the floor below. The crowd rushes out, eager to see if there are still seats available. Your back is continuously squeezed and prodded by others—quite the unpleasant experience.
You and the mysterious girl are the last two to exit the elevator. Kelvin and Cabernet come over to you and shake their heads.
You understand what they mean: they didn't find Macchiato amongst the crowd.
You look around. This floor isn't as bright and colorful as the one above, and the dim lighting is hardly appetizing.

The main hall is decorated with strange sculptures and recreational machines. As opposed to the "game and recreation area" described in the manual, this floor is more like an escape room that one wants to flee from as soon as possible.

steps.speaker: Guest A
steps.content: Where is she? All of us arrived at the same time. Who'll get a seat and who won't?

steps.speaker: Guest B
steps.content: What is this place? I thought we were coming down here to eat?

steps.speaker: Guest A
steps.content: What the... Is she playing a prank on us? ... Didn't even finish my soup!

steps.speaker: Guest C
steps.content: It's a prank all right! We just went up the stairs and saw that there was no one left upstairs!

steps.speaker: Guest C
steps.content: Is there some hidden camera rolling?! Do they want to see us make a fool of ourselves?!

steps.speaker: Guest D
steps.content: The stairs? I just checked the stairs, it's locked already...

steps.speaker: Guest D
steps.content: I just came down with the final batch. You guys were arguing too much, so I wanted to go back and finish my soup. But the elevator's not working anymore, so I figured maybe I can take the stairs...
The elevators stopped working?!
The mysterious girl reacts even faster than you and rushes to the elevator, but all the lights on the panel have been turned off. No matter how hard she presses the buttons, there's no response.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Girl
steps.content: Ahhhh great. Now the elevators is out of use!

steps.speaker: Mysterious Girl
steps.content: That's why I said it's dangerous down here! Not one ever listens to me and they all rush downstairs!

steps.speaker: Mysterious Girl
steps.content: Putting your life at risk just to try some strange new food...? Stupid!
The girl suddenly stops as if she realizes something, then looks up at you.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Girl
steps.content: Ah, it's you! The one who also got squeezed flat against the wall back there...!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What... what a coincidence.
The girl glances at you, then at Cabernet and Kelvin. She suddenly comes up to you and whispers with lowered eyes:

steps.speaker: Mysterious Girl
steps.content: P-please keep this between you and me... Help me, I beg of you...

steps.speaker: Mysterious Girl
steps.content: It's extremely dangerous down here. There are things beyond your worst nightmares... It's truly terrible. You've got to believe me. We have to get back upstairs!
The girl repeats what she had been mumbling in the elevator. You look at the shut-off elevator and locked stairwell. You don't have a good feeling about this, either.
Just as you're about to ask the girl something, ear-piercing static grabs everyone's attention.

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: Ahem, can everyone hear me?
The crowd looks around, but the head chef is nowhere to be seen. Only her voice echoes in the air. It's as if she's monitoring you all from above.

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: Dear guests... please quiet down.

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: I did say that the seats for the dinner banquet are first-come-first-served... but...

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: One must meet certain standards to be eligible. You will encounter different challenges at random times and places. Whether or not you're honorable enough for a seat will be judged on your performance.

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: After all, only honorable souls are worthy of dining with the noble, elegant and perfect Miss Cabernet.
McGrath's words cause an uproar among the crowd. Some of the guests begin to curse her angrily.

steps.speaker: Guest C
steps.content: You personally invited me here! What, am I not worthy enough now?!

steps.speaker: Guest D
steps.content: Honorable soul? Worthy? What are you talking about? What challenges? What if we fail?! Is this some kind of battle royale?!

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: What if you fail? You'll be eliminated, of course. Haven't you noticed that some of you have already been "eliminated"?

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: So, everyone here has already passed the first challenge. If you're not confident about being worthy enough to dine with Miss Cabernet, I can eliminate you right here. Is there anyone who doesn't want to participate?
The agitated crowd calms down somewhat. Everyone is whispering to each other about the situation at hand: Challenges? A judgment of worthiness?
In the end, no one steps out to say no. Everyone seems to think it's just a game.

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: Then, let the new challenge commence! Please complete the game as soon as possible, my dear guests.
McGrath commences the game. Having accepted the rules, the guests quickly scatter. However, you suddenly see red and feel intense pain. A chill goes down your spine.
An ominous premonition suddenly strikes you. Weathering the pain, you activate your shackles... and sure enough, Macchiato's end feels incredibly weak.
Your face turns ashen... this party is way too creepy. It even took Macchiato away from you without a fight.
Just like on the top floor, Cabernet observes the farcical scene from afar, deep in thought. You get up and walk over to her.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: You don't look well. What happened?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Something happened to Macchiato. This isn't a normal game, Miss Cabernet.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If what that guest says is true, there's no one left upstairs. Macchiato isn't on this level, either.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: According to my senses... the signal from Macchiato is very weak. Something must have happened to her.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This game is surely dangerous, Miss Cabernet. Did you know this would happen? If you know anything else about this, please share it with me.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Otherwise, I'll have to apologize and abort your mission. Finding my Sinner is a much bigger priority for me.
Cabernet looks at you in silence for a long time, as if trying to decide whether or not to tell you something.
There's no one left around you. Even that mysterious girl has left to search for clues after realizing you have no way of going back upstairs. It's incredibly quiet around you right now.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: I don't know the chef named McGrath very well. If you want to learn about her from me, all I can share is only some rumors and faint impressions of mine.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: I did hear rumors about the legendary ingredient she got, as well as the legendary powers, but I just assumed she made them up to win my approval...

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Last time we met, McGrath didn't get the approval she wanted from me, but she didn't yell at me like the others, or vow to win me over next time...

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: She simply gave me an invitation to this feast a month later, saying that she got my favorite ingredients and will make cuisine that I'd love for sure.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This coincides with you losing your treasures... which is why you suspect your treasures may be in her hands?

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Correct. I pretty much guessed that she had my treasures. I was worried that something might happen to them, so I pulled some strings to get a seasoned professional to help me... which is you, dear Chief.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: I know I've caused trouble for you. I didn't expect things to come to this, either. She has become crazy, and even started harming innocent people...
You look deep into her eyes. You sense that she's not being completely honest with you, but this isn't the time to make a fuss.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What's happened has happened. No need to apologize... There's no way back up. If we want to find Macchiato, we'll have to participate in this strange game, win a seat at the banquet, and negotiate with the chef.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm just curious, why didn't she bring you directly to Level B2 like she did with the Thaumas Society's Ocean Messenger? Why is she making you play this game with the other guests?

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: You'd have to ask Miss McGrath herself. But if you ask me, I do love watching the best ingredients be transformed into delicacies through the art of cooking.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: This is probably... her way of seeking approval.
Cabernet shakes her head as she watches the guests run around, and lets out a quiet sigh.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: I'll try my best to assist you, protect you from McGrath, and find your companion...

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: As well as find my precious... treasures.
